title: Send money with Zelle
persona: Retail checking customer paying a friend back
customer_goal: Get money to someone I know, in minutes, without worrying

scope.starts: Customer opens Zelle in the mobile app
scope.ends: Payment confirmed, or a problem resolved

governance.access_policy: Need-to-know: study sponsors and journey owners

moments.title: Open Zelle
moments.customer_action: Taps Send & Receive with Zelle in the app
moments.frontstage: Zelle hub with Send, Request and Activity; first-timers see Get started

fail_points.text: Ineligible account hits a dead-end message

moments.emotion_note: Neutral — expects it to be quick

moments.title: Enroll email or mobile
moments.customer_action: Chooses email or U.S. mobile number and enters a one-time code
moments.frontstage: Token pre-filled from profile, code sent by text, terms shown

fail_points.text: Token already enrolled at another bank, so the customer must move it

moments.handoff: App → SMS for the one-time code

moments.title: Find recipient
moments.customer_action: Picks a contact or types an email or mobile number
moments.frontstage: Shows whether the recipient is ready to receive

fail_points.text: A typo pays a stranger's token
Recipient not enrolled, so the payment will sit pending

moments.title: Confirm who it is
moments.customer_action: Checks the name shown before continuing
moments.frontstage: Registered name shown with an "only send to people you know" message

fail_points.text: Imposters register names that look legitimate

moments.title: Enter amount
moments.customer_action: Enters the amount and an optional memo
moments.frontstage: Shows available balance and today's remaining limit

fail_points.text: Limit hit with no path to raise it

moments.title: Review and send
moments.customer_action: Reviews the details and taps Send
moments.frontstage: Summary; a step-up code or purpose question appears only when risk is high

fail_points.text: A scammer coaches the customer through step-up

moments.title: Payment executes
moments.customer_action: Waits a few seconds on the sending screen

fail_points.text: Network timeout leaves the status unknown
Unworked breaks return weeks later as "missing money" calls

moments.title: Get confirmation
moments.customer_action: Sees confirmation; the recipient hears from their own bank
moments.frontstage: Confirmation number, amount and recipient; "usually available in minutes"

fail_points.text: Sender sees Completed while the recipient sees nothing yet

moments.title: Track activity
moments.customer_action: Checks status in Activity and cancels if still pending
moments.frontstage: Status: Completed, Pending (recipient not enrolled), Expired or Canceled

moments.title: Report a problem
moments.customer_action: Reports a wrong recipient, a scam or an unauthorized payment
moments.frontstage: Claim taken; customer told next steps and timeline

fail_points.text: Authorized scam payments often aren't covered, an expectation gap
Customer repeats the story across channels

moments.handoff: App → chat → phone; customer often repeats the story

variants.name: Happy path
variants.trigger: Customer (enrolling if needed) pays an enrolled recipient
variants.scope_rule: Lists the moments that change or matter on this path; omitted moments behave as the happy path or do not occur

variants.name: Fraud hold or step-up
variants.trigger: Risk score is high at Review and send

notes.urn:kos:moment:wells-fargo:zelle-send:m0: Step-up code, or payment held for manual review; customer sees 'We're reviewing this payment'
Runs only after review clears; delay of minutes to hours
Confirmation arrives late; this is the moment trust is won or lost

variants.scope_rule: Lists the moments that change or matter on this path; omitted moments behave as the happy path or do not occur

variants.name: Recipient not enrolled
variants.trigger: Directory lookup finds no token at Find recipient

notes.urn:kos:moment:wells-fargo:zelle-send:m0: Customer told the recipient must enroll to receive
No registered name to show — highest wrong-recipient risk
Funds held; recipient gets an invite to enroll
notes.urn:kos:moment:wells-fargo:zelle-send:m1: Pending until claimed; expires and returns per network rules; cancel allowed

variants.scope_rule: Lists the moments that change or matter on this path; omitted moments behave as the happy path or do not occur

variants.name: Scam claim
variants.trigger: Customer reports being tricked after paying

notes.urn:kos:moment:wells-fargo:zelle-send:m0: Warning was shown but the customer trusted the scammer
Payment was authorized by the customer, sometimes after step-up
Irrevocable once accepted; only a recall request is possible
notes.urn:kos:moment:wells-fargo:zelle-send:m1: Claim classified; qualifying imposter scams follow network recovery rules; others may not be covered

variants.scope_rule: Lists the moments that change or matter on this path; omitted moments behave as the happy path or do not occur
